text: Editor is Neovim with a custom Lua config; refuses to use VS Code.
Shell is fish, not bash, on personal machines.
Prefers dark themes; dislikes pure black, uses a warm dark grey background.
No meetings before 10am local time; mornings are for deep work.
Wants conventional commits (feat:, fix:, chore:) with no emoji.
Drinks espresso, specifically a double shot, no sugar. Owns a manual lever machine.
Prefers prose documentation over bullet lists for anything conceptual.
Insists on tests being written before the implementation, not after.
Reviews PRs by reading the diff, never trusting the description.
Hates animated spinners and progress bars; prefers plain text status.
Takes notes in plain text files, never in a note app with a database.
Prefers boring, proven technology over new frameworks.
Lives in Portugal, in Lisbon specifically.
Speaks Portuguese fluently, including reading technical docs in it.
Speaks German at a conversational level, learned living in Berlin.
Works as a backend/platform engineer, ~8 years experience.
Has a degree in physics, moved into software later.
Works at a company in the payments space, around 40 engineers.
Timezone is Europe/Lisbon (WET/WEST), which matters for scheduling.
Runs a home lab with a self-hosted DNS resolver and a VPN back to it.
Primary machine is an M2 MacBook Pro, 32GB RAM, 1TB disk.
Uses macOS on the laptop and Debian on the home server.
Home server is a mini PC with an N100 CPU and 16GB RAM.
Terminal is Ghostty with a minimal prompt showing only git branch.
Uses JetBrains Mono at 13pt in the terminal.
Types on a split ortholinear keyboard, not a standard layout.
Dotfiles are managed with a bare git repo, no stow or chezmoi.
Backs up to a USB SSD monthly, no cloud backup for personal files.
No discrete GPU anywhere; does not do local model inference.
Uses a de-Googled Android phone, no Google Play services.
Default browser is Firefox with strict tracking protection.
Work CI is GitHub Actions; home projects use a self-hosted Forgejo runner.
Version control is git, with rebase-and-merge; squash merges are discouraged.
Branch names are ticket-prefixed, e.g. PAY-1234-add-refunds.
Primary language is Go; writes Python for scripts and tooling.
Datastores are Postgres for OLTP and ClickHouse for analytics.
Message broker is Kafka, managed internally, not a cloud offering.
Deploys are containerized on Kubernetes, on-prem rather than cloud.
Secrets are managed in Vault; no secrets in env vars in production.
Monitoring is Prometheus and Grafana, with PagerDuty for paging.
Incident channel is Slack #inc-payments; all sev-1s get a written postmortem.
Internal docs live in a self-hosted wiki, not in the git repo.
Travels to Berlin about four times a year for family.
Vegetarian, but eats fish; no red meat or poultry.
Wakes around 06:30, sleeps by 22:30 on weekdays.
Runs three times a week, training for a half marathon in November.
Has two cats, both rescues, one named Miso.
Does not drink alcohol; orders sparkling water at work events.
Reads science fiction; currently working through the Culture novels.
Tracks personal spending in a plain spreadsheet, no budgeting app.
